password_setting.label: OpenAI API Key
password_setting.help: OpenAI API key for authentication. Generate from your OpenAI account settings under API keys.

additional_config_fields.label: Tags
additional_config_fields.help: Comma-separated list of custom tags to apply to OpenAI metrics and logs for organization and filtering (e.g., 'team:ai,env:prod').

toggle.label: LLM Observability
toggle.help: Enable LLM Observability to gain end-to-end visibility into your LLM application, including performance, costs, and quality metrics.

toggle.label: Cloud Cost Management
toggle.help: Enable Cloud Cost Management to monitor OpenAI API usage costs and identify optimization opportunities.
